casebody.head_matter:
Helen Pritchard et al v. W. T. Burnside et al.
No. 7975.
Decided January 6, 1943.
(167 S. W., 2d Series, 159.)
W. T. Williams, W. T. Williams, Jr., and Sterling Williams, all of Austin, Angus Wynne and Harrington & Harrington, of Longview, for petitioners.
The Court of Civil Appeals erred in holding that there was no evidence to support the verdict of the jury finding that the owners of the land placed the southeast corner of block 3 on the north bank of the Sabine River 2 degrees and 18 minutes west from the southwest corner of the Rains survey. Beck v. Gulf Oil Co., 113 S. W. (2d) 258; Blackwell v. Coleman Co., 94 Texas 216, 220, 59 S. W. 530; Davis v. George, 104 Texas 106, 134 S. W. 208.
Thompson, Mitchell, Thompson & Young, of St. Louis, Mo., Lacey & Price, of Longview, Palmer Bradley, P. G. McElwee, W. B. Wagner, J. P. Adoue, Barksdale Stevens, A. E. Groff and R. H. Whilden, all of Houston and Dam Moody, of Austin, for respondents.
W. Edward Lee, of Tyler, filed brief as amicus curiae.
